questions.q: Luffy's rubber body comes from which Devil Fruit, as originally named?
questions.why: Eating it made him a rubber man, though the fruit's real nature is revealed much later.

questions.q: Who gave Luffy his iconic straw hat?
questions.why: Shanks, Luffy's idol and mentor, lent him the hat.

questions.q: Which studio produces the One Piece TV anime that premiered in 1999?
questions.why: Toei Animation's anime began on Fuji Television on October 20, 1999.

questions.q: Luffy's sworn brothers are Sabo and which other?
questions.why: Ace and Sabo are Luffy's sworn brothers.

questions.q: Which Marine vice-admiral is Luffy's grandfather?
questions.why: Garp is Luffy's grandfather, while Dragon, leader of the Revolutionary Army, is his father.

questions.q: On what date is Luffy's birthday?
In what year did One Piece begin in Weekly Shōnen Jump?
questions.why: Chapter 1, Romance Dawn, appeared in Weekly Shōnen Jump in 1997.

questions.q: Luffy's rubber fruit turns out to be which Mythical Zoan?
questions.why: It is the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika, awakened in Gear 5.

questions.q: Who is Luffy's Japanese voice actor?
questions.why: Mayumi Tanaka has voiced Luffy in Japanese from the start.

questions.q: Oda said he first aimed for a kind of manliness similar to which series?
questions.why: Oda initially modeled Luffy's manliness on Akira Toriyama's Dragon Ball.
